wins.label: Running business momentum
wins.evidence: Nike Running growing over 20% this quarter

wins.label: North America wholesale recovery
wins.evidence: Wholesale grew 11% in North America, spring order book is up year-over-year

wins.label: Marketplace inventory health
wins.evidence: Inventory decreased 2% versus prior year, units down in North America, EMEA and Greater China

wins.label: Sport Offense organizational restructuring
wins.evidence: Realigned approximately 8,000 teammates to Sport Offense in early September

wins.label: Digital promotional discipline
wins.evidence: Reduced number of site-wide promotion days by more than 50 and lowering markdown rates

risks.label: Tariff headwinds escalating
risks.evidence: Gross incremental cost to NIKE on annualized basis now approximately $1.5 billion, up from $1 billion, increasing gross margin headwind from 75 to 120 basis points

risks.label: Greater China structural decline
risks.evidence: Greater China revenue declined 10%, NIKE Direct down 12%, NIKE Digital down 27%, EBIT declined 25%

risks.label: NIKE Digital traffic collapse
risks.evidence: Organic traffic has slowed, NIKE Digital declining 12% in Q1, expected to face more significant headwind in Q2

risks.label: Sportswear business weakness
risks.evidence: Sportswear business continues to decline, classic footwear franchises managing 30% decline in North America

risks.label: Cautious consumer environment
risks.evidence: We are turning our business around in the face of a cautious consumer, tariff uncertainty and teams that are still settling into the Sport Offense
